summary:
ServiceNow 上一季 EPS 超預期4%，營收3.57億美元，工作流平台動能穩健。
• EPS 0.92 美元，較預估0.89超出3.95%。
• 營收3.57億美元（B級），規模穩健。
• IT、員工與客戶工作流平台滲透持續擴大。
• Now Assist 等 GenAI 產品逐步貢獻增量。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 穩定超預期，反映 ServiceNow 工作流平台的黏著度與擴張能力。本季營收年增率未揭露，但結合下一季22%成長，動能強勁。短期業績支撐股價，中期關鍵在 GenAI（Now Assist）變現與跨工作流平台擴張。追蹤指標：訂閱營收年增、cRPO、NRR 與 AI 產品 ACV 貢獻。62倍本益比要求持續高成長，AI 兌現是維持估值的核心。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢需後續確認。；本益比62.42偏高，要求持續高速成長。；企業 IT 支出循環性與競爭風險。

summary_en:
ServiceNow beat EPS by 4% with $3.57B revenue, on steady workflow-platform momentum.
• EPS of $0.92 beat the $0.89 estimate by 3.95%.
• Revenue of $3.57B held a solid scale.
• IT, employee, and customer workflow penetration keeps expanding.
• GenAI products like Now Assist increasingly add incremental value.

訊號偏正面：EPS 穩定超預期，反映 ServiceNow 工作流平台的黏著度與擴張能力。本季營收年增率未揭露，但結合下一季22%成長，動能強勁。短期業績支撐股價，中期關鍵在 GenAI（Now Assist）變現與跨工作流平台擴張。追蹤指標：訂閱營收年增、cRPO、NRR 與 AI 產品 ACV 貢獻。62倍本益比要求持續高成長，AI 兌現是維持估值的核心。

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: a steady EPS beat reflects the stickiness and expansion of ServiceNow's workflow platform. Revenue YoY was undisclosed, but with the following quarter's 22% growth, momentum is strong. Near-term earnings support the stock; mid-term hinges on GenAI (Now Assist) monetization and cross-workflow expansion. Track subscription revenue growth, cRPO, NRR, and AI-product ACV contribution. A 62x P/E demands sustained high growth, with AI delivery central to holding the valuation.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, requiring later confirmation.; A high P/E of 62.42 demands sustained high growth.; Enterprise IT spending cyclicality and competition pose risks.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出3.95%，穩定優於市場共識。
